findings.problem: The slice contract (future-result.md 'Slice 14 ... Frontend files' and 'WHY THESE NEWS? panel') requires a separate component `src/app/result/why-news-panel.ts` (selector `app-why-news-panel`, input `research: ResearchExplanation`), a host signal named `whyNewsOpen`, and the panel rendered as a `mat-card` with Material chips (`mat-chip-set` is listed in the UI section). The implementation inlines the panel into `WhySourcesComponent` as a plain `<section class="panel">`, the chips are `<span class="chip">` with no `mat-chip-set`/aria-label, the signal is `newsOpen`, and no `why-news-panel.ts` exists. Behaviour is correct, but the file/selector/Material contract is not met.
findings.fix: Extract the panel markup into `why-news-panel.ts` (`app-why-news-panel`, `research = input.required<ResearchExplanation>()`), render the root as `<mat-card data-testid="why-news-panel">` and the drivers as `<mat-chip-set aria-label="Driven by" [attr.data-testid]=...><mat-chip ...>`; in `WhySourcesComponent` rename `newsOpen` to `whyNewsOpen` and render `<app-why-news-panel [research]="research()" />` while open. Keep the existing data-testids so the tests stay green.

findings.problem: `research` is declared `input<ResearchExplanation | null>(null)` although FutureResult.research is required in the contract; if it were ever missing, `open-why-news` would show aria-expanded="true" while no `why-news-panel` renders (silent no-op).
findings.fix: Make it `input.required<ResearchExplanation>()` (the contract guarantees it) or render the panel with an empty research fallback.
